## 2024-05-18 - Optimize message utility array allocations
**Learning:** Intermediate arrays generated by chaining methods like `.filter().map()` or `.flatMap()` on large collections (like the message history array) inside frequently invoked functions (`getToolUseIDs`, `getToolResultIDs`) cause excessive garbage collection pressure and noticeable overhead.
**Action:** Replace functional array method chains with single `for` loops that directly populate the target data structure (e.g., a `Set` or an object map) in performance-critical hot paths.
